statement: A business required to issue a security breach notification to more than 500 California residents as a result of a single breach must electronically submit a single sample copy of that notification, excluding any personally identifiable information, to the Attorney General within 15 calendar days of notifying affected consumers (Civil Code § 1798.82(f)); the Attorney General's breach reporting page carries the submission channel.
caveat: The 15-calendar-day submission deadline is the section text current as of January 1, 2026; the Attorney General's reporting page states the more-than-500-resident submission duty without the day count, so read the two sources together. The sample copy supplements, and does not replace, the resident notifications themselves. This repo does not prepare or submit breach notices.
